items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I played with Tom a long time, too.

ctx.x: He live a block from him, right down in the French quarters. Oh, yeah. On St. Peter Street.
Oh, yeah. That's from Tom Alba? That's right, near Tom Alba. Is Tom live there yet? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
